fine_trace.note: Attacker-controlled UART bytes are fed to the NCP UART handler; the buffer contains HDLC-framed spinel frames.
HDLC decoder extracts spinel frames from the UART buffer; each frame is dispatched to NcpBase::HandleReceive.
Spinel command is dispatched; SPINEL_CMD_PROP_VALUE_INSERT with SPINEL_PROP_THREAD_ON_MESH_NETS adds a prefix to local network data.
A prefix with a small BorderRouter TLV (length 4, one entry) is added to the local network data.
Local network data change triggers a CoAP POST to 'a/sd' carrying the Thread Network Data TLV with the small BorderRouter TLV.
Leader processes the first CoAP message; the prefix with the small BorderRouter TLV is added to the leader's mTlvs.
